## Context / Problem
The src/rebar/reconciler cohort contains audited comments or docstrings that obscure current behavior with repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, or historical detail. The current sweep is pinned to `b10a2309d65b4128c30dd7839a6d9905b8158e63`.

## Approach
Edit explanatory text only in this directory/subsystem cohort. Condense it to current, non-obvious rationale and constraints; retain every file-specific preserve item and consumer contract below. Grouping adjacent files from one subsystem keeps the change reviewable in one session and permits one coherent verification pass without changing executable behavior.

## Scope

The source cohort moved from `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` to `src/rebar/reconciler/`. The semantic DD command lists the exact 172 current block IDs. Ten old targets were deleted or absorbed by an already selected docstring. Four import or key anchors were updated to their current spellings. The stale SilentTruncationError docstring is also included because the current 1200 ceiling and offset-stall trigger had been omitted from its description. The current-parent source is authoritative for prose and word counts.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Every listed location contains only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints after remediation; verified by reviewing the final diff against every Scope row.
- [x] Every preserve item and consumer contract in Scope remains explicit and accurate; verified by a row-by-row completion comment and the commands under Verification.

## Verification
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/python scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`
